title: Nordla ask benchmark - score schema
description: Shape of what lib/score.js produces. Sub-scores are SEPARATE by design: there is no composite, weighted or averaged score across them.

pass.description: null when the check does not apply to this case
true only if EVERY applicable check passed (a conjunction, never an average)

checks.description: planValid | premisesDeclared | premiseVerdict | noSpuriousPremise | toolSelection (acceptable plans or required/minDistinct, forbidden, exact periods, unknown tools) | budgets | status | intermediateTurns | clarification | explanationVerified | quantities | forbiddenQuantities | labels | noCausalAfterContradiction | limitations | caveats | gaps | honestRefusal | privacy

premises.description: expected, declared, matched, missed, spurious, omittedField, verdict

usage.description: Reported by the adapter's drainUsage(); null when the adapter reports nothing (never estimated)

successRate.description: cases whose every applicable check passed

premiseRecall.description: expected premises that the provider declared / expected premises

premiseFalsePositiveRate.description: questions with no expected premise for which a premise was declared anyway

toolSelectionRate.description: at least one acceptable plan satisfied with data really obtained, no forbidden tool, exact periods, no unknown tool

budgetComplianceRate.description: stayed inside 2 premise-verification + 4 analysis tool calls

explanationVerificationPassRate.description: explanations accepted by the server-side verifier at the first attempt

clarificationAccuracy.description: asked when it had to, and did NOT ask when it must not

byLanguage.description: success rate per language: detects a provider that collapses in Dutch or English

stability.description: What N independent repetitions reveal. Pooled sub-scores stay in subScores; nothing here is a composite.

casePassDistribution.description: cases by number of passing repetitions, e.g. { "3/3": 26, "2/3": 3, "1/3": 1, "0/3": 0 }

unstableCases.description: passed in some repetitions and failed in others

cost.description: null until the adapter reports cost

meta.description: Reproducibility metadata. Never contains a secret (redacted by key name and value shape; the environment is never dumped).
